exceptions.reason: n8n-workflow 2.44.1 pins its zod peer to 3.25.76, and its @n8n/expression-runtime 0.35.0 depends on zod 3.25.76. Zod 4.6.6 is the first fixed version. Both reach only the development tree, and the package ships no zod.

Every minimatch release before 11.0.1 carries it. eslint 9.29.0, which @n8n/eslint-plugin-community-nodes pins as a peer, asks for minimatch 3, and eslint-plugin-import-x 4.17.1 imports makeRe, which minimatch 11 removed, so an override stops eslint from loading. The n8n community node rules also reject an overrides field. Minimatch reaches only the lint tooling in the development tree, and the package ships no minimatch.
